record.question: Jeff Bezos briefly overtook Microsoft's Bill Gates to become the world's richest person. He is the founder of which company?
record.explanation: Answer C: Amazon. Amazon’s own founder biography states Jeff Bezos founded Amazon.com in 1994. The historical wealth-ranking lead-in does not alter the founder identification. Reference: https://ir.aboutamazon.com/officers-and-directors/person-details/default.aspx?PersonId=19954. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
